Raj -

Appreciate the clear list. Below are our responses and the artifacts we can share immediately. I’ve attached a short runbook excerpt and a sample SOC attestation for reference. For anything that requires additional approvals we’ve noted expected timelines.

SOC 2:
- Current posture: Redwood has completed SOC 2 Type I and maintains ongoing control evidence. A Type II engagement is in progress with an expected completion date of 2026-09-01.
- Immediate artifacts: redwood_soc2_sample_attestation.pdf (sample attestation), SOC2_summary.pdf (high level control mapping). For customers requiring an interim solution, we provide bridge letters and control evidence exports under NDA/secure share.

GDPR / DPA / Data Residency:
- DPA: we have a standard DPA and Data Processing Addendum; we can share the DPA via our secure share link and are open to standard FinTechCorp redlines.
- Region pinning: Hosted production data can be pinned to eu-west-1 for EU accounts; we also offer Private deployments for full data residency requirements.

HIPAA / BAA:
- We support execution of a BAA for covered PHI workloads. Process: we typically sign a customer-specific BAA; the DocuSign/contract path is standard (link below). For technical controls: encryption (at-rest and in-transit), KMS integration, access logging, and role-based access controls are in place.

Incident response / notification SLAs:
- Preliminary acknowledgement: within 24 hours of detection/confirmation of a security event affecting a customer.
- Customer notification: confirmed breach notifications to impacted customers within 72 hours of confirmation.
- Remediation updates: initial remediation plan within 5 business days; regular status updates until closure.
- RTO / RPO: Target RTO = 4 hours for critical inference endpoints (depending on deployment); RPO = 15 minutes for critical KV cache/state. Detailed RTO/RPO depend on deployment model (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- Evidence: attached redwood_incident_response_runbook_excerpt.pdf and dr_evidence.zip (sample tabletop and recovery evidence).

Vendor questionnaire / next steps:
- We will complete the FinTechCorp vendor questionnaire. Preferred return method: secure-share (link below) or we can fill your PDF and return. Expect a first-pass completed questionnaire by 2026-06-18.
- If useful, let’s schedule a 30-minute call next week for your security team to review artifacts together - Jordan/Marissa, please propose times.

If you need any legal sign-off (DPA/BAA), Marissa will coordinate with Legal and Procurement - turnaround typically 5-10 business days after redlines.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
